description: Run after set-project-architecture, set-module-details, set-entry, or set-entries. Returns a compact report (summary, stats, issues by kind)—no need to load the full project in the agent. Checks only known rules: dataFlow consistency, module↔entry links, module detail files, entry index drift, empty api/domain/persistence slices, entry slice coverage, optional module-too-few-entries when moduleEntryMin is set. If catalog JSON is corrupt, run fix-data first. Fix issues[] then call validate again.

checkEmptySlices.description: Warn when api/domain/persistence slices have zero entries but modules exist (default true)

checkEntryCoverage.description: Check modules vs entries linkage (default true)

checkInverse.description: Check providesTo vs dependsOn inverse (default true)

checkModuleEntryCounts.description: Check module-too-few-entries when moduleEntryMin is set (default true)

checkSliceCoverage.description: Check entries match at least one built-in or custom slice (default true)

checkStorage.description: Check module files on disk and entry index drift (default true)

moduleEntryMin.description: Min entries per module when count > 0; omit to disable module-too-few-entries

projectId.description: Required. Call list-projects first (query by workspace folder name) and pass the matching projectId. Never omit. default-project is forbidden.

name: validate
title: Validate Project
